```plato
//==
// # Splines
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Bezier splines
//  - B-splines and NURBS
//  - Hermite curves
//  - Interpolating splines

//==
// # Bezier splines
//
// Control-point curves of the Bezier family: arbitrary-degree Bezier curves,
// their rational (weighted) form, and chains of cubic segments. Parallel arrays
// (points + weights) must have equal counts; that invariant is documented rather
// than encoded. Evaluation lives in `splines.library.plato`.

//==
// # Bezier curves of arbitrary degree

// A Bezier curve of arbitrary degree in the plane: degree = control point
// count - 1 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve). Interpolates
// the first and last control points.
type BezierCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point2D>;
}

// A Bezier curve of arbitrary degree in space: degree = control point
// count - 1. Interpolates the first and last control points
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type BezierCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point3D>;
}

// A rational Bezier curve in the plane: per-point weights (same count as
// ControlPoints) pull the curve toward heavier points. Represents conic
// sections exactly (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type RationalBezierCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point2D>;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
}

// A rational Bezier curve in space: per-point weights (same count as
// ControlPoints) pull the curve toward heavier points
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type RationalBezierCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point3D>;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
}

//==
// # Composite Bezier curves

// A chain of cubic Bezier segments in the plane; consecutive segments must
// share endpoints (P3 of one equals P0 of the next). Font glyphs and vector
// paths in curve form
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Composite_B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type CompositeBezier2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Segments: Array<CubicBezier2D>;
}

// A chain of cubic Bezier segments in space; consecutive segments must share
// endpoints (P3 of one equals P0 of the next)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Composite_B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type CompositeBezier3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Segments: Array<CubicBezier3D>;
}

//==
// # B-splines and NURBS
//
// The knot-vector curve family: piecewise-polynomial B-splines and their
// non-uniform rational form, the CAD interchange standard. Parallel arrays
// (points + weights) must have equal counts, and the knot count is fixed by the
// point count and the degree; those invariants are documented rather than
// encoded. The knot accessors live in `splines.library.plato`.

//==
// # Knots

// A non-decreasing sequence of parameter values partitioning a B-spline or
// NURBS domain (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B-spline#Definition). For a
// curve with N control points of degree D the knot count must be N + D + 1.
type KnotVector
    implements IValue
{
    Knots: Array<Number>;
}

//==
// # B-splines and NURBS

// A piecewise-polynomial B-spline curve in the plane
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B-spline). Knots must hold ControlPoints
// count + Degree + 1 values.
type BSplineCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point2D>;
    Degree: Integer;
    Knots: KnotVector;
}

// A piecewise-polynomial B-spline curve in space. Knots must hold
// ControlPoints count + Degree + 1 values
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B-spline).
type BSplineCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point3D>;
    Degree: Integer;
    Knots: KnotVector;
}

// A non-uniform rational B-spline curve in the plane: a B-spline with
// per-point weights (same count as ControlPoints)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Non-uniform_rational_B-spline). The CAD
// interchange standard; represents conics exactly.
type NurbsCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point2D>;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
    Degree: Integer;
    Knots: KnotVector;
}

// A non-uniform rational B-spline curve in space: a B-spline with per-point
// weights (same count as ControlPoints)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Non-uniform_rational_B-spline).
type NurbsCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point3D>;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
    Degree: Integer;
    Knots: KnotVector;
}
```
